segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey, do you have two minutes on the Northstar renewal proposal? They're asking for the 73-seat extension co-termed to March 31, and they want the paper by tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, I saw the email. Price stayed at $62 per seat monthly, right? Plus the $4,800 enablement package?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Right. The numbers are simple. What's killing me is getting the proposal out. I have to put the same 73 seats, March 31 end date, $54,312 annualized, net 30, and the enablement line into the pricing sheet, then retype it into the quote tool, then the contract generator, then the billing tool so finance can validate, and then the approval portal for deal desk. None of them pull from each other, and if I change one date I have to walk the whole chain again. Last quarter this exact kind of extension took me parts of three days, not because of negotiation, just because every screen wanted the same fields in a different format.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, that's rough. For Northstar, don't change the discount once you start the packet. Their procurement team is pretty literal, so if one place says 12 months and another says through March 31, they'll kick it back.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: That's what I'm trying to avoid. The customer doesn't care how we assemble it, they just want a clean order form and the two-page proposal before their budget meeting at 10 a.m. Central.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Could you use the standard extension template and leave the services as a separate line? Deal desk approved that structure for Bayview last week.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, I can. I already checked the pricing sheet and it stays inside the floor, so it's not a discount exception. I just need your eyes on the co-term language before I send it.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Send me the draft language when you have it. I'd say, 'Subscription term ends March 31, 2026, aligned to existing agreement number 1847.' Keep the payment terms as net 30.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Perfect. If I can get through the tools without fat-fingering the seat count, I'll have it to you by 4:30.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Sounds good. I'll turn it fast so you can get it to Northstar tonight.
